project_type: Forge app for Confluence (Custom UI macro + byline + global settings, Rovo agent + GET actions, rovo:mcp, async index consumer). Scaffolded by Task 0 (FEAT-001): contracts, stubs, tests, manifest.
language: TypeScript (strict) for backend functions, pure core and Custom UI (React + Vite)
build_system: npm (single package; Forge CLI bundles src/; Vite builds static/ui to static/ui/dist)
test_framework: Vitest + fast-check for unit and property tests under test/; Playwright (+ @axe-core/playwright) for static/ui against a Vite build with a mocked @forge/bridge
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build:ui
test_command: npm test && npm run test:e2e (created in FEAT-001)
verification_instructions: 1. npm ci. 2. npm run typecheck. 3. npm run lint. 4. npm test (Vitest, includes banned-words and manifest contract tests). 5. npm run build:ui. 6. npm run test:e2e (Playwright). 7. npx forge lint once forge login is done (deferred until the user logs in). See PLAN.md section 13.
snapshot_or_generated_files: static/ui/dist is a build output referenced by manifest resource 'ui' (do not commit unless Forge deploy needs it; forge deploy runs from local build). Demo tarball fixtures are generated at test time from demo/payments-api/ (not committed). No snapshot dirs yet.

environment_constraints: macOS zsh. No git remote configured. Never push or deploy to production without asking the user. Development deploys to the demo site are approved; production deploys and any git push need explicit user approval (demo repo push in Task F is approved). The data volume was ~100% full during Task 0; avoid big caches. Free tier only, no paid APIs, no Forge LLM. Context7 MCP not available; use developer.atlassian.com or the Forge MCP server https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/forge/mcp. Must stay unrelated to the user's other entry LotZero (no recall/food/compliance themes, no shared code).
contribution_requirements: From the user: strict TypeScript, Vitest unit tests, Playwright for UI, deterministic claim extraction (regex + small grammar), read-only by default, all page/repo/action text treated as data, wording uses 'contradicted by code' / 'no evidence found' and never 'wrong' or 'safe', Jira writes only after an explicit click with exact text shown first. No em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Pure core in src/core (no Forge imports, enforced by ESLint no-restricted-imports). One check service (src/service) used by macro, byline, Rovo actions and MCP. Contract types in src/core/model.ts (PLAN.md 7.1). All user-facing sentences from src/core/wording.ts. Contradicted requires complete coverage for that index kind; otherwise Unknown. Index sharded in KVS (values < 200 KiB) with a pointer key flipped last. Agent envelope schema pil.agent.v1 with untrusted* fields (PLAN.md 9.2). tsconfig.json must NOT set noEmit (Forge ts-loader needs emit); typecheck passes --noEmit. Forge string fields are limited to 255 chars (action descriptions).
directory_structure: Planned layout in PLAN.md section 3.2: src/core (pure logic), src/repo (GitHub/Bitbucket sources, tar reader), src/storage (KVS), src/service (check service), src/resolvers (Custom UI resolvers, byline dynamicProperties), src/actions (Rovo/MCP actions), src/consumers (index queue consumer), static/ui (Custom UI + e2e), prompts, skills, demo, test.
